messages:
maya (PM): Quick sync — API-first minimal onramp vs. full Console admin surface. Customers ask for console gating; eng prefers API-first. Need sequencing decision and launch criteria.
lee (Eng): API-first is lower friction and much faster. Console admin + RBAC + audit is 3-4wks extra. Risk: customers could misuse API without UI guardrails.
jonas (DevEx): Middle ground: ship API + CLI now, add a tiny Console "managed defaults" toggle (read-only) to reduce misuse. Buys time for full admin.
taylor (Design): Agree. If API-first, include a visible onramp checklist in the console with warnings and links to docs — not a full admin UI.
alex (Sales): Heads-up: a few enterprise P0s literally require console audit logs & model pinning in UI before signing. We need concrete launch criteria or concessions.
maya (PM): Proposal: sequence = (1) API-first public SDK/docs + small Console safety toggle (read-only) (2) Phase 2: full admin controls + RBAC + audit logs. Quick RICE calc: Reach=6, Impact=8, Confidence=70% -> `score = (6*8*0.7)/3 ≈ 11.2` (effort estimate=3).
lee (Eng): Sounds reasonable. Add canary: enable the console safety toggle only for Dedicated / enterprise accounts first.
taylor (Design): Acceptance criteria we should require: no critical security gaps, console checklist implemented, front-end e2e tests covering the toggle, updated UX copy for warnings.
maya (PM): Draft launch criteria (short):
• API docs + SDK examples shipped
• Console safety toggle visible for onramp (read-only)
• E2E + security test pass
• Sales enablement + contract clause for phased features
• Monitoring dashboard + cost guardrails in Console
jonas (DevEx): I'll draft the rollout playbook + rollback steps and add feature-flagging recipes. Will coordinate with ops.
ops-bot: Reminder — maintenance window Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC available for canary rollout. :white_check_mark:
alex (Sales): If the customers demand Console features now, Sales will ask for temporary concessions — credits or timeline SLAs. Can we commit to phase dates?
maya (PM): Target alpha in ~3wks. Owners: lee -> infra & feature flags; jonas -> rollout docs; taylor -> onramp checklist & copy; alex -> contract language. I'll write the PRD with phased milestones and attach the RICE appendix. :rocket:
lee (Eng): I'll queue infra spikes and a minimal feature-flag implementation.
jonas (DevEx): Will author the playbook and a short QA checklist for beta customers.
taylor (Design): I'll push microcopy & checklist mock in Figma by Friday.
alex (Sales): Thx — I'll update the affected deals and flag any customers that cannot wait.
maya (PM): Great — next sync Friday 10:30am PT. If anyone objects to the sequence, shout now. :point_up:
_meta: generated slack thread about prioritization tradeoffs: API vs Console, RICE scoring, launch criteria, sequencing
